title: Quantum-Corrected Evaporation and Absorption Cross-Section of Near-Extremal Rotating Black Holes
summary: We revisit the Hawking evaporation history of low-temperature rotating black holes by taking into consideration the strong quantum fluctuations known to be present in the near-horizon, near-$\mathrm{AdS_2}$ throat region governed by an effective action that includes Schwarzian and two gauge modes. Imposing compatibility of this quantum framework with the semiclassical results creates a novel link of the black hole angular momentum and electric charge before and after emission, leading to a nontrivial interplay among the superradiance effect, eigenstate thermalization hypothesis and…
